text: Living being a local in my 84 ball bow I don't like when assholes touch my radio Extreme exit in excess too I don't give a fuck what you all listen to You only hear the best, any less is a felony Boy, Eddie Murphy really felt out of melody Without Boy George I don't think I'd survive I go through 12 letters when I listen to the lines The new buzz ballads in my tape deck I got a brand new relief from my grandpa Jeb Fatt Crowds be stills, gnashing young I'll crank the bass when I hear Aqualung Hall, Oates, Millie, Vanilli, you say Ocean I say Billy, Caribbean Queen
